Meet the Cat

Aleksei Vinogradsky

BA Hons in Architectural Studies · BA Arts in Music

A professional, whose over 10 years of experience in various design fields, passion for creativity and interest in different and distinct arts disciplines — architecture, visual arts, drawing, music and literature — has led to an unusual though strong understanding and feel for precise and effective decision making with a unique, task-specified approach.

Cooperation includes many leaders of the industries such as L'Oreal, Lancome, Accor, Unilever, Carlsberg, Ahmad, Swarovski, Armani, YSL, Prada, Valentino, Kerastase, Biologique Rechenche, Carita and many more.
